# FairwayPal

> FairwayPal (https://www.fairwaypal.com) is a free golf trip planner for groups. The organiser answers five questions (destination, dates, group size, budget per round, vibe) and FairwayPal generates a dual itinerary: a golf schedule for the players and a parallel plan for non-golfing partners, scheduled into the gaps when the golfers are on the course. One link goes to the group, everyone votes In or Out on each activity, and the organiser locks the trip. FairwayPal does not take bookings or payments; it links out to GolfNow, Expedia and GetYourGuide (some links are affiliate links). The site also publishes honest, partner-aware destination guides, month-by-month "where to golf" guides, and practical planning guides on budgets, logistics and group dynamics.

## Destination guides

- [Scottsdale, Arizona](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/scottsdale): desert golf, Old Town, spa scene; best October to April
- [Myrtle Beach, South Carolina](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/myrtle-beach): best-value US beach golf
- [Pinehurst, North Carolina](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/pinehurst): Pinehurst No. 2 and a walkable village
- [Bandon Dunes, Oregon](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/bandon-dunes): walking-only links golf on the Pacific coast
- [Pebble Beach, California](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/pebble-beach): Monterey Peninsula and Carmel-by-the-Sea
- [Kiawah Island, South Carolina](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/kiawah-island): The Ocean Course plus Charleston
- [Florida](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/florida-golf): Streamsong, TPC Sawgrass, winter sun
- [Scotland](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/scotland): St Andrews, Carnoustie, Royal Dornoch
- [Ireland](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/ireland): Ballybunion, Lahinch, Old Head of Kinsale
- [Algarve, Portugal](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations/algarve): European sun golf and sea caves
- [All destinations](https://www.fairwaypal.com/destinations)
